description: Search 7,906 global airports by city name, airport name, metro code (e.g. NYC, LON, TYO), or partial IATA code to resolve valid 3-letter IATA airport codes before calling route tools.

country.description: Optional 2-letter ISO country code (e.g. US, JP, GB) or country name filter.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching airports to return (1-20, default 8).

query.description: City name, airport name, metro code (e.g. NYC, LON, TYO), or partial IATA code (2-80 chars).

name: search_airports
